name: The Spear of Bashenga
oracle_text:
When The Spear of Bashenga enters, if there is no monarch, you become the monarch.
Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has vigilance.
Whenever equipped creature attacks the monarch, destroy target tapped nonland permanent that player controls.
Equip {2}
blocked_sentences: Whenever equipped creature attacks the monarch, destroy target tapped nonland permanent that player controls.

needs.what: a `defending: "monarch"` clause on the `attacks` trigger, matching only when the creature was declared attacking the monarch PLAYER (not a planeswalker or battle that player controls/protects), mirroring how `defending: "most_life"` (dethrone) rejects events carrying `attacked_permanent`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The nearest spelling is `attacks` with `filter: {attached: true}`, `condition: {is_monarch: {binding: defender}}` and `recheck: false` (as M'Baku, Jabari Chieftain does), but `defender` is the planeswalker's/battle's controller on an attack against a permanent, and neither `condition_keys` nor any binding can read `attacked_permanent`, so the card would also destroy a permanent whenever the equipped creature attacks a planeswalker the monarch controls -- a different card. `_defender_matches` only knows `you`, `opponent` and `most_life`.
